CA.governing_law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
CA.fee_dispute_notice: If a dispute arises about fees, you may have the right to request non-binding fee arbitration through the applicable local bar association program before any lawsuit is filed.
CA.e_signature_note: The parties consent to electronic signatures under the California Uniform Electronic Transactions Act.

NM.governing_law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New Mexico.
NM.fee_dispute_notice: Questions or disputes about fees should first be raised with the responsible professional; unresolved disputes may be referred to an available fee-arbitration program.
NM.e_signature_note: The parties consent to electronic signatures under the New Mexico Uniform Electronic Transactions Act.

NY.governing_law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.
NY.fee_dispute_notice: In the event of a fee dispute, you may have the right to seek arbitration under the state's fee dispute resolution program. A copy of the program's notice will be provided on request.
NY.e_signature_note: The parties consent to electronic signatures under the New York Electronic Signatures and Records Act.

TX.governing_law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.
TX.fee_dispute_notice: Questions about fees should first be raised with the responsible professional. Information about the grievance process is available from the state bar.
TX.e_signature_note: The parties consent to electronic signatures under the Texas Uniform Electronic Transactions Act.

FL.governing_law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Florida.
FL.fee_dispute_notice: Fee disputes that cannot be resolved informally may be submitted to the applicable bar fee-arbitration program, where available.
FL.e_signature_note: The parties consent to electronic signatures under the Florida Electronic Signature Act.
